notes.title: 1.1.0.1 Minifix
notes.notes:
- Fixed : Mp4 Video was not exporting if there is no folder named 'Sequence' during export.
- Fixed : Before Pixelate Basic and Pixelate Advanced modules, if there was a module that changed the image size (Scale, Image Resize etc.), the image would be corrupted.
- Added : Plus and minus buttons to numeric value sliders

notes.title: PixageFX Pixel Art 1.1.0.0 is OUT!! New features, New modules!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41407671/4f2a8c72ccf1eec5284ec2fcc5250a9370546285.png[/img]
New Feature : [b]TEMPLATES[/b]
Now there are ready-made templates in PixageFX Pixel Art too! 
We have also added the Template system to PixageFX Pixel Art, which has been in PixageFX Studio for a while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41407671/bd4cb2b25ff6c125e1032517eb6011b2d5a422f0.png[/img]
Now there are more modules in PixageFX Pixel Art.
The world's most successful pixelation module 'Pixelate Advance AI' in Pixage FX Studio is now available in PixageFX Pixel Art.
In addition, we have added other modules. Please visit our website to see all modules and differences with PixageFX Studio.

notes.title: PIXEL ART WORKSHOP STRIKES AGAIN!!!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41407671/8da0ad353cfa6ff73707470abce7a31c4dcd6f6e.png[/img]

As you know, a while ago we decided to change the name of Pixel Art Workshop and continue as PixageFX. Now we offer Pixel Art Workshop as a cheaper and somewhat restricted version of PixageFX. Although it doesn't have all the effects in PixageFX, it has all the effects to convert an image to pixel art. PixageFX costs $29.99, while Pixel Art Workshop costs $9.99. There is also a 40% discount exclusive to the first release. We think that we have prepared a package suitable for our new users who only need basic effects for pixel art conversion.
